svg.title: Raspi Guardian — private Telegram group
svg.desc: Sample data. Guardian Demo is a synthetic private Telegram group with two members, including the Raspi Guardian bot. The bot is identified as the sender of both automatic UPS notifications. The original English messages and complete inline navigation menus are preserved, with Docker enabled. Button rows: 📊 Status / 🔋 UPS; 🖥 System / 💾 Disks; 🐳 Docker / ❔ Help; 🌐 Language; ↻ Refresh.
